name: Ginataang Kalabasa

ingredients.name: long beans, cut into 5 cm lengths

steps: Seed the squash and cut it into even 3 cm cubes, leaving tender skin on if using kabocha. Cut long beans into 5 cm pieces and keep separate so they are added later.
Heat oil in a wide pot. Cook onion for 4 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and green chilies and stir for 1 minute without browning the garlic.
Add squash, vegetable stock, half the coconut milk and salt. Cover and simmer gently for 10–12 minutes until squash is nearly tender but holds its shape.
Add long beans and remaining coconut milk. Simmer uncovered for 6–8 minutes until beans are tender-crisp and squash is fully cooked; do not boil vigorously or the coconut sauce may split.
Season with soy sauce and black pepper, rest 3 minutes and serve over rice. Use a clearly labelled vegetarian seasoning to keep this coconut stew plant-based.
tips: Use firm squash and add beans near the end; both should remain distinct in the creamy coconut sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
